description: Repeatedly proposes and applies one experiment at a time, runs the benchmark, and keeps changes only when they beat the current best result.
name: autoresearch

steps.prompt: Read {{research_directions}} and the latest result in {{benchmark_path}}. Propose and apply one change. Run the benchmark. If the result beats the current best, commit and update {{benchmark_path}}. Otherwise revert and log the failed attempt. Leave the workspace clean before returning.
